description: This file initializes a React application by rendering the main 'App' component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It sets up the ReactDOM root and wraps the app with React.StrictMode for highlighting potential issues.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the DOM within the created React root.
